reviewType: Assistant engineering perspectives; no independent external experts or human aesthetic evaluation
decision: Keep already-safe anchor; explore existing own anchors only after full-phase infeasibility; actual MP4 guards required before adoption.

MV_direction.benefit: Avoid losing a complete sequence due to one unreadable entry placement while retaining music-conditioned sequence optimization.
MV_direction.risk: Safe placement can still be repetitive; a valid anchor is not proof of creative improvement.
MV_direction.counterproof: Full30 and independent completed-movie comparison required; no forced alternation or random variation.

typography.benefit: Same original glyph/font/layout and every existing phase safety condition retained.
typography.risk: Anchor movement can alter relative margins or background visibility.
typography.counterproof: Per-phase native geometry plus final decoded per-glyph safety and exact internal-unit binding.

music_information.benefit: Audio, LRC and timing are untouched.
music_information.risk: A different placement may weaken intended section contrast even when legible.
music_information.counterproof: Complete music-observation population and unchanged music-fit tradeoff guards.

optimization.benefit: Recover actually feasible complete-state alternatives before sequence search; refresh existing pixel terms after moving anchor.
optimization.risk: Locally feasible candidates may not improve whole-film utility.
optimization.counterproof: Shipping incumbent preserved and actual delivery comparison rejects unmeasured/regressing alternatives.

render_encode.benefit: No new renderer, effect or shared-renderer prototype; actual camera state and phase observations retained.
render_encode.risk: Additional native probes increase preparation time; encoding variability can confound contribution.
render_encode.counterproof: Native adopted hashes and original/ON/ON-repeat/OFF decoded-clock comparisons; encoder noise is measured, not excused.

QA_release.benefit: Cause and rejected-anchor attempts are machine-readable; thresholds/coefficients unchanged.
QA_release.risk: Current-source effect/global evidence is not complete yet.
QA_release.counterproof: No main merge until exact-head CI, current completed-MP4 quality and important effect gates pass.
